title: The Turisbook Booking System WordPress plugin through 1.3.8 does not have authorisation and CSRF checks when saving…
description: The Turisbook Booking System WordPress plugin up to version 1.3.8 lacks authorization and CSRF protections when saving settings and fails to sanitize and escape one setting before displaying it in an admin page. This allows unauthenticated users to conduct stored cross-site scripting (XSS) attacks against administrators.
